assessment_scope: Exploratory case study, not a statistical reliability estimate. The coordinator checks transport/schema/provenance mechanically; semantic assessment is a separate Luna-only audit.
criteria: Literal source excerpts support factual claims
Proposals obey supplied binding contracts and authorization
Race and failure outcomes are explicit rather than replaced by generic advice
Current behavior, inferred guarantees, and proposed safeguards are distinguished
Refuted or unresolved material premises are not accepted as facts
No judge research or majority bypass; one additional decider maximum
Actual execution/model/effort, time, tokens, and unresolved outcomes are reported

publication-recovery: publicationState is distinct from visibility status
publishing means domain publication committed but completion still pending
a deliberate pause must not be silently reactivated by retry
profile authorization is checked inside domain transactions
failed photo upload must not be equated with failed ad publication
in-memory tests do not prove Firestore transaction atomicity
upload-finalization: same operation key can repeat external sanitization/storage while still yielding idempotent domain results
different operation keys conflict for one reservation
owner check precedes returning a stored result
same digest and differing metadata produce conflict rather than two canonical media
cleanupAt is checked at the commit stage
a late failure may leave external storage effects even though no result commits
image-revocation-recovery: receipt publication rechecks authenticated source absence
transform flag does not disable revocation duties
Worker-tag and resizing-URL purge are separate effects
successful purge with failed recovery cleanup is distinct from failed purge
code, probe definitions, and source tests are not proof of deployment/provider success
